label: Facing North
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed toward magnetic/true north recording south-facing building elevation or feature.

label: Facing North-East
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed northeast recording oblique elevation or corner.

label: Facing East
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed east recording west-facing elevation or interior wall.

label: Facing South-East
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed southeast recording oblique elevation or corner.

label: Facing South
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed south recording north-facing elevation or interior wall.

label: Facing South-West
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed southwest recording oblique elevation or corner.

label: Facing West
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed west recording east-facing elevation or interior wall.

label: Facing North-West
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed northwest recording oblique elevation or corner.

label: Plan View (Facing Down)
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed vertically downwards recording floor fabric, ground surface, footings, or floorboard shrinkage gaps.

label: Ceiling View (Facing Up)
volunteer_identification_guide: Camera pointed vertically upwards recording roof framing, rafters, battens, ceiling roses, or shingles.

label: Oblique Perspective
volunteer_identification_guide: Three-quarter angled shot showing relationship between two walls, verandah junction, or machinery layout.
